answer: Seat graders by graph distance: a panel may only include identities whose join and referral paths share no ancestor within three hops of the answerer. Like a pearl that forms only around a foreign grain, trust then comes only from outsiders. A sybil farm sitting on one knoll of the graph must first grow standing in distant, unrelated clusters, and each of those identities needs its own ferrous record of solo work, so attack cost scales with graph distance, not key count.
